title: Harness Function
description: A function the agency's own harness advertises to a rogue (unplatformed) syndicate and executes on its behalf. The call signature is the function-calling convention shared by Ollama /api/chat and OpenAI /v1/chat/completions: a name, a description, and a JSON Schema for the arguments.

function_name.description: The name the model calls and a mission lists in allowed_tools. Must appear in some channel_capability's harness_tools: that table, not this one, decides which capability the function implies.

parameters.description: JSON Schema (type: object) for the call arguments, sent to the model verbatim as tools[].function.parameters. Shaped like MCP Tool.inputSchema; constrained structurally so validation stays offline.

depot_tool.description: Slug of the depot tool (tools.json) an agent must hold to be offered this function, or null when the function is a basic faculty every agent has.

handler.description: Executor method in lib/dispatch/harness/executor.py that runs the call.
